run_export_commentaries: run the export function to export expert commentary data for released takes to a target directory
run_check_export: run the check_export function to verify all exported commentary files exist at their destination paths
build_export_pipeline: build a pipeline to export expert commentary transcriptions and recordings for released Ego4D takes
review_export_function: review the export function that organizes commentaries by take name and generates copy commands
refactor_export_for_cli: refactor the export function to accept takes path and released takes path as CLI arguments
